question: Should the canonical `agent-transcript` skill accept GitHub Copilot local session files as a first-class source for content that may be published to PR and issue bodies?
rationale: This is a new public-facing data source with a privacy policy boundary; source-level correctness cannot determine the repository’s acceptable support and maintenance commitment.

options.title: Accept with strict proof
options.body: Approve Copilot as a supported source after the contributor posts redacted current-head rendering and focused sanitizer validation for the final commit.

options.title: Keep existing sources only
options.body: Decline the new Copilot source and retain the current Codex, Claude, Pi, and OpenClaw-only discovery surface.

recommendation.title: Accept with strict proof
